question: The name of Guru Kelu Charan Mohapatra is primarily associated with which of the following dances?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Odissi.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Odissi is one of the 8 classical dances of India recognized by the Sangeet Natak Academy.**
 
• Odissi is a major ancient classical dance that originated in the Indian state of **Orissa.**
 
• The famous dancers of Odissi are - **Sujata Mohapatra, Kelucharan Mohapatra, Ratikant Mohapatra, Gangadhar Pradhan, etc.**
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra is the first person to receive the Padma Vibhusan from Orissa**.
